findings: READMEの現行19節と変更範囲を照合。Visual directionで撮影高の比較を追記し、MCPの手順に動作の終点、読順と視線を反映した。版・説明・PDF・本体とスキルの配布先・既存FourPanel資産を候補版と照合。作画の自動保証、固定の役名札や画角の追加は記載しない。
manualFindings: 3冊78ページを旧版と描画比較し、全ページのA4判型とv8.1.7表記を検査した。本文が変わったGeminiガイド1ページ、全機能14・19・23・24ページを目視し、文字・枠の重なりや欠けを確認した。

pricingReview.findings: Compared OpenAI Standard text/image rates with Batch and verified Gemini 3.8 Flash dated Standard/Batch prices and Nano Banana 2.1 Standard image/token prices. The existing pricing settings and documented image rates agree with the official tables.

apiValidation.scope: The same scoped camera source was tested in a v8.1.6-labelled isolated build. The reported six-panel color STEP3 completed with HTTP 200 and gpt-6-luna, with fallback disabled. The original shallow-low-angle sentence was preserved. The explicit-eye-level control stopped before the API. The v8.1.7 version bump and documentation changes do not modify this logic.
